narr: Heavy rain fell across northwest Indiana on May 8th into the morning of May 9th producing localized flooding. Rainfall amounts included 2.58 inches one mile southwest of De Motte; 2.43 inches two miles northwest of Valparaiso; 2.11 inches four miles northeast of Hebron and 2.10 inches six miles south southwest of Hebron.
ev: Approximately 6 inches to one foot of flowing water was reported across Route 2 on the north side of Hebron.
